# Quick Brief: Exit-Ticket Cadence

## Summary

Exit tickets give teachers a fast read on each lesson in the cadence trial [3]. Daily two-question tickets lift retention of covered material by a clear margin [1]. Completion stays under three minutes when each ticket holds two questions [2]. Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [3]. The retention data favours the daily cadence with a strict question cap [1].

## Key Points

- Daily two-question tickets lift retention of covered material by a clear margin [1].
- Completion stays under three minutes when each ticket holds two questions [2].
- Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [3].

## Action Items

- Adopt daily exit tickets with a cap of two questions [1].
- Review the weekly aggregate every Friday during planning period [2].
- Revisit the decision at half term with the retention data [3].
